draft:
**Our SAP S/4HANA Team**

Amaris brings a proven SAP Centre of Excellence to this engagement. For a major German manufacturing group, we assembled a 16-consultant team, including 11 SAP-certified professionals spanning the full functional landscape: FI/CO, MM, SD, and PP modules.

This breadth of module coverage ensures that cross-functional integration — often the most complex aspect of S/4HANA programmes — is addressed by specialists who understand both the functional depth and the interdependencies between modules.

**Senior Programme Leadership**

Our proposed Programme Director brings 18 years of SAP delivery experience and holds PMP certification. This combination of technical depth and project management rigour has been central to our track record of delivering complex SAP programmes on schedule and within scope.
